test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following rivers does NOT rise in the Nepal Himalayas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narmada.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Narmada river originates from** Amarkantak** and rises from the **Maikal ranges.**
 
• The Maikal are a hilly region in** central India. **
 
• Amarkantak is located in the Shahdol district of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• Narmada river mainly flows in central India.
 
• Hence it is not from** Nepal Himalayas.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Gandak River originates from Nhubine Himal Glacier in the Mustang District in Nepal.

 
 
• It is also known as Narayani or Gandaki.
 
• It is one of the major rivers in Nepal.
 
 
 
• **Ghaghara** originates from Nampa of Nepal and enters Bihar at Gopalgunj.
 
 
• Ghaghara ​joins River Ganga at Chhapra. 
 
 
 
• Kosi is an antecedent river with its source to the north of Mount Everest in Tibet, where its mainstream Arun rises.
